title: Table Serialization Determines Which Relations Language Models Preserve
abstract: arXiv:2610.24798v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study how text serialization affects table lookup in instruction-tuned language models. Our diagnostic asks the model to find the row containing a specified value under one named column, then return the value under another named column in that same row. We render the same synthetic 256-cell tables in row-major form and in column-major form with each header placed beside its values, while varying the table aspect ratio across five shapes. Across three models, the better format changes with table shape: row-major performs better on tall tables, whereas column-major performs better on wide tables. At 64 x 4, row-major leads by 42.3-54.0 percentage points; at 4 x 64, column-major leads by 35.0-59.0 points. Mapping wrong answers back to their source cells reveals a complementary error pattern: row-major tends to preserve the correct row but lose the target column, while column-major tends to preserve the correct column but lose the row

translated_title: 表格序列化决定了语言模型保留哪些关系
translated_abstract: 我们研究了文本序列化方式如何影响指令微调语言模型中的表格查找。我们的诊断任务要求模型找到某一命名列下包含指定值的行，然后返回该行中另一命名列下的值。我们将相同的合成256单元格表格分别以行优先形式和列优先形式（每个表头放置在其对应值旁边）进行渲染，同时在五种形状中改变表格的宽高比。在三个模型上的实验表明，更优的序列化格式随表格形状而变化：行优先格式在窄高表格上表现更好，而列优先格式在宽扁表格上表现更好。在64×4的表格上，行优先格式领先42.3-54.0个百分点；在4×64的表格上，列优先格式领先35.0-59.0个百分点。将错误答案映射回其源单元格后，我们揭示了一种互补的错误模式：行优先倾向于保留正确的行但丢失目标列，而列优先倾向于保留正确的列但丢失行。
tldr: 该研究发现表格的序列化格式决定了语言模型在表格查找中保留哪些关系——行优先格式更适合窄高表格（倾向保留行但丢失列），列优先格式更适合宽扁表格（倾向保留列但丢失行），且这一结论在多个模型上保持一致。
en_tdlr: The serialization format of a table determines which relations language models preserve during lookup: row-major excels on tall tables (preserving rows but losing columns), while column-major excels on wide tables (preserving columns but losing rows), a pattern consistent across models.
